prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A beautiful polished hand-painted cute storybook game ANIMAL sprite sheet. Exactly 3 rows, eight columns, no humans. One distinct animal species and anatomy per row, same identity in every cell. Entire body, ears, tail, wings, feet must be visible, never cropped or overlapping. Generous 15 percent clear transparent gutters between all cells and 5 percent outside margin. Genuine transparent alpha, NO scenery, labels, boxes, grid lines or cast shadows. Three-quarter elevated view facing right, crisp dark soft outlines, warm appealing painted details. First four columns are a smooth moving cycle, last four are another species-appropriate action loop. Clear motion changes, not copied poses. All EIGHT poses and ALL 3 rows, including the final row, fully drawn. Distinct real anatomies and silhouettes, no recolours.
ROW 1: 花びらのたてがみを持つ獣 (空想動物). four different walking poses with alternate legs forward in columns 1-4; four grooming, sniffing, feeding or playful poses in columns 5-8.
ROW 2: 葉の背びれを持つ魚 (空想動物). four clearly different swimming poses in columns 1-4; four turning and tail/fin flexing poses in columns 5-8.
ROW 3: 大きなヒレで浮かぶ空の魚 (空想動物). FOUR different phases of airborne wing beats in columns 1-4; four hovering or turning poses in columns 5-8.
